span.label: THE APPLICABILITY NULL IS THE CONTROL THAT RULES OUT A VALENCE ACCOUNT, AND IT IS THE HARDEST WORKING RESULT IN THE PAPER: `the ABSENCE of any effects for NONAPPLICABLE trait terms suggested that exposure to trait terms with positive or negative associations WAS NOT IN ITSELF SUFFICIENT to determine attributions and evaluations.` Positive and negative words that did not FIT the target did nothing. So the effect is not mood, not evaluative contagion and not `nice words make you nicer` - it needs a CATEGORY the target can be sorted into. **Necessary-but-not-sufficient, stated in 1977**, and the same logical shape unknown2009 states for object recognition thirty-two years later
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE DELAYED EFFECT IS BIGGER THAN THE IMMEDIATE ONE, AND THE EXPLANATION IS CORRECTION RATHER THAN ACTIVATION: `It may be that an AWARENESS that one's categorizations are BIASED accounts of the stimulus information can function as a `DISCOUNTING CUE` ... that ATTENUATES the direct impact of the categorizations.` The activation does not grow; the correction fades. **So awareness here REDUCES the measured effect, and an immediate test UNDERSTATES it** - the opposite sign to Holcomb2005, where prime visibility PREDICTED the size of semantic priming. Two literatures with awareness pushing the measurement in opposite directions, which is a reason to record the direction and not only the presence of an awareness check
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A SECOND NULL SEPARATES TWO ROUTES: a category could bias judgement INDIRECTLY, by distorting what is remembered, or DIRECTLY, through its own implications. Reproduction of the description was unaffected, so `the characterization and evaluation effects found were Quotation withheld.` **The prime changed what people concluded without changing what they recalled** - which is what makes this a claim about judgement rather than about memory, and it is settled by an absence
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THEY UNDERCUT THAT NULL THEMSELVES, IN THE NEXT PARAGRAPH. Subjects `probably felt they should MEMORIZE the stimulus information because it was part of a `reading comprehension` test`, and Spiro (1975) found that reconstructive errors do NOT occur under memorise instructions - so `Reproductive errors consistent with the activated categories MIGHT HAVE OCCURRED in the present study if subjects had been given different instructions.` The absence that carries their direct-effect conclusion is attributed to their own design rather than to the world, in the same discussion that uses it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE AMBIGUITY CONDITION IS HERE TOO, IN 1977, AND THAT MAKES THREE PAPERS ACROSS 38 YEARS. `Quotation withheld.` North1999 says the effect holds `only when there is an element of UNCERTAINTY in product choice or when customers are in a state of LOW INVOLVEMENT`. money2013 says `a situation that does not leave much room for interpretation is unlikely to show a consistent or large priming effect`. **Social psychology 1977, marketing 1999, social psychology 2015 - the founding paper, a field study and a reply to a failed replication - all naming the same condition: a prime needs somewhere to act.** Higgins states it first and almost in passing, as a qualifier on a sentence about something else
